title: The Bare Kernel and the Mother Axiom
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: trureturing cyberpunk · the bare CIC kernel with three primitives, four reductions and the finite tree of 3, three classical-axiom cards, a 47-point fraction grid with its least gap 1/132, integer circle products on the rational circle, the three Mother Laws, a local group around any home point, a contradictory axiom, a Nat match blocked by its scrutinee, an erasable Prop proof, and a schematic typeclass tested on Q8
summary: Before any classical library loads, Lean's kernel is bare CIC: dependent functions, universes and finite inductive types, four reductions beta, delta, iota, zeta, and 3 as the finite tree succ succ succ zero; Classical.choice, Quot.sound and propext enter only through classical shortcuts, a literature result labelled argued. The strict floor decides equality of exact fractions by cross-multiplication (12/18 = 2/3, 3/4 ≠ 2/3), and the precision contract ε = 1/M (a model) at M = 12 gives 47 reduced fractions in [0, 1] whose least gap is 1/132; on the rational circle, [1 : 2] ⊙ [1 : 3] = (5, 5) ~ [1 : 1] and [1 : 2] ⊙ [2 : 5] = [9 : 8] raise the horizon from 3 to 9 (all computed on screen and re-checked by a second route). The Mother Axiom AXIOM-Ω keeps only a ternary transport and a fidelity κ under three laws (model, schematic picture), with infimum zero allowing readings arbitrarily close to zero; κ ≤ 1 from the Gram form with weights 1 and −1 and the local group around any home point o follow the chapter's derivations (argued). At the zero quadruple the specified reading is 0, while the raw reflexivity axiom requires it to be 1. A match on an unimplemented Nat axiom stalls, while a subtype projection still returns 42 with its axiomatic Prop proof erased. The book packages operations with certificates in a typeclass. Q8 with constant κ ≡ 1 meets the listed fields (checked on screen), but fails separation at (1, −1) and has infimum 1. English narration with Chinese and English subtitles.
summary_zh: 导入任何经典库之前，Lean 的内核是裸 CIC：依值函数、宇宙层级与有限归纳定义，β、δ、ι、ζ 四条归约，3 是一棵有限的树 succ succ succ zero；Classical.choice、Quot.sound 与 propext 只借经典捷径混入，这一类型论元理论按文献结果标为论证。严格地板用交叉相乘判定精确分数的相等（12/18 = 2/3，3/4 ≠ 2/3）；精度契约 ε = 1/M（模型）取 M = 12，[0, 1] 中 47 个既约分数的最小间距是 1/132；在有理圆上，[1 : 2] ⊙ [1 : 3] = (5, 5) ~ [1 : 1]，[1 : 2] ⊙ [2 : 5] = [9 : 8] 把视界从 3 抬到 9（均为屏幕计算，并以第二条途径复核）。母公理 AXIOM-Ω 只留三元迁移与保真度 κ 及三条法则（模型，迁移图为示意），读数下确界为零，允许任意逼近零；由权重 1 与 −1 的格拉姆二次型得 κ ≤ 1，以任一点 o 为家得到局部群，按本章推导标为论证。在零四元组处，指定的读数为 0，而裸自反公理要求它为 1。对无实现的自然数公理做模式匹配会卡住，子类型值则可在擦除 Prop 证明后投影出 42。本书把运算与证书写成类型类。取常值 κ ≡ 1 的 Q8 满足所列字段（屏幕核对），但 κ(1, −1) = 1，读数下确界为 1，既不分离也不触零。英文旁白，中英双语字幕。
